recipe_name: Legendary Abilities: Archive of Tal Rasha
inputs: Khanduran Rune + Caldeum Nightshade + Arreat War Tapestry + Corrupted Angel Flesh + Westmarch Holy Water + 5 Death's Breath + the item whose power is to be extracted (item destroyed)
output: Extracted legendary power, permanently learned (per game mode), selectable into 3 Cube slots (weapon/offhand, armor, jewelry)
notes: Re-selection/replacement free; fails with no cost if power already extracted or cannot be extracted

recipe_name: Crafting Materials: Pleasure of Iben Fahd (convert Reusable Parts)
inputs: 1 Death's Breath + level 70 equippable Normal/Magic/Rare item (controlling ingredient) + stack of Reusable Parts (100 consumed, excess returned)
output: 100 of the material matching the controlling item's rarity (Normal item → Reusable Parts; Magic → Arcane Dust; Rare → Veiled Crystal)
notes: One of three conversion recipes; choice of recipe decides which material is CONSUMED, controlling item decides which is PRODUCED

recipe_name: Crafting Materials: Regret of Iben Fahd (convert Arcane Dust)
inputs: 1 Death's Breath + level 70 equippable Normal/Magic/Rare item (controlling ingredient) + stack of Arcane Dust (100 consumed, excess returned)
output: 100 of the material matching the controlling item's rarity

recipe_name: Crafting Materials: Wrath of Iben Fahd (convert Veiled Crystal)
inputs: 1 Death's Breath + level 70 equippable Normal/Magic/Rare item (controlling ingredient) + stack of Veiled Crystal (100 consumed, excess returned)
output: 100 of the material matching the controlling item's rarity

inputs: 1 Essence of the desired gem color (Essence of Amethyst / Diamond / Emerald / Ruby / Topaz, bought from Squirt the Peddler for 500,000 gold each; controlling ingredient) + stack of 9 non-legendary gems of one color and quality (9 consumed, excess returned)
output: 9 gems of the same quality in the chosen color

inputs: 50 Forgotten Souls + 5 Khanduran Rune + 5 Caldeum Nightshade + 5 Arreat War Tapestry + 5 Corrupted Angel Flesh + 5 Westmarch Holy Water + the legendary item to reforge
output: Same legendary identity with ALL powers and stats re-randomized as a fresh drop (item level kept; patch-buffed attributes NOT applied to outdated items; socketed gem returned)
notes: Can roll Ancient/Primal/non-Ancient at approximately normal drop rates regardless of original quality; Smart Loot always active (never another class's primary stat); nullifies Enchanting/Ramaladni's Gift modifications

recipe_name: Set Items Conversion: Skill of Nilfur
inputs: 10 Forgotten Souls + 10 Death's Breath + the Set item to convert (set must have at least 3 items)
output: Another random item of the same set, fresh roll (socketed gem returned)
notes: New item never rolls Ancient even if the old one was

recipe_name: Upgrading Rare Items: Hope of Cain
inputs: 25 Death's Breath + 50 Reusable Parts + 50 Arcane Dust + 50 Veiled Crystal + level 70 Rare item (can be crafted, bought, or looted)
output: Random Legendary or Set item of the same item type (weighted by that item's normal drop rate; cannot award Horadric Cache-only items)
notes: Smart Loot always applies; 10% chance to be Ancient and (if Ancient) additional chance to be Primal; may roll Torment-exclusive items; class-specific and generic items in the same slot are not interchangeable

inputs: Gem of Ease (rank 25 or higher) + the item to modify
output: Item's required character level set to 1, no other effect
notes: Cannot be used on Legendary Gems; works on any quality incl. Set and recipe-produced items

inputs: Legendary Gem of sufficient rank (Weapons/offhand: rank 30+; Jewelry: rank 40+; Armor: rank 50+) + 3 Flawless Royal gems of one color (controlling ingredient: Ruby=Strength, Topaz=Intelligence, Emerald=Dexterity, Amethyst=Vitality) + the Ancient (or Primal) item
output: Ancient item with a separate bonus of +5 to the chosen core attribute per rank of the consumed Legendary Gem
notes: Recipe can be reused but overwrites (not stacks) the previous augmentation; extra gems in the stack returned; Whispers of Atonement designed as fuel; in Soul Shard seasons an upgraded Soul Shard functions as a rank 50/75/100/125 gem

notes: Only one upgraded Primal Item may be worn at a time
